title: TrackerOptions
description: Input dictionary passed from the web page to typst/tracker.typ. Extends specs/001-printable-habit-grid/contracts/tracker-options.schema.json with one new optional `title` property; every other property is unchanged.

title.description: Optional freeform page title. Empty string means no header is rendered (FR-002). The 200-character cap is a defensive input limit, not the rendering rule — long titles are clipped at the printable width regardless (research.md §1).
